game.name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeons of Infinity (4:3 Edition)
game.desc: 4:3 layout patch for the PortMaster 1.1.6 VM build. A classic Zelda HUD keeps health, magic, the equipped item, and counters visible during gameplay. Click the right stick to toggle compact equipment, minimap, and dungeon panels. The title, profile menus, and playfield fill the Nova display. Select + Start exits.
